summary: Added canonical order-invariant input fingerprint binding validated executions, vectors, row digests, gold IDs and criteria; output retains query/passage digest bindings and reports FP32 as required storage target with supplied and observed storage unavailable.
API: Version 1 analyze(mapping) keeps the prior request shape. input_fingerprint hashes length-framed canonical records documented in the module; query and paired-vector results retain input_digest and representation_digest. candidate_storage separates required_target_dtype, supplied_dtype, observed_dtype and provenance.
limitations: Supplied vectors and execution labels are unverified; storage is not observed or supplied. No model, hardware, production storage, service or held-out qualification was performed. Input fingerprint binds admitted float values; it does not authenticate their provenance.
